title: PaperWorkbenchManifest
description: Versioned in-folder manifest binding a Paper aggregate to its Vault sources. See ADR-006.

schema_version.description: Manifest schema version. Bump only with a migration path.

paper_id.description: Stable random UUIDv4 identity. Never derived from path, title, or PDF hash (ADR-006).

title_override.description: User-supplied display title. When null, title is derived from folder name then source stem.

sources.description: Paper 1:N PaperSource. A paper may legally have multiple PDFs and multiple translations.

note.description: Optional note binding. A paper without a note is legal.

annotation_store.description: Relative path (no ..) to the annotation sidecar. See ADR-008.

tags.description: Paper-level semantic tags. Note-level tags live in the note frontmatter (ADR-007).

external_ids.description: Optional external identifiers. Never used as the Paper identity.

inactive_at.description: Soft-removal marker. Physical deletion of a Paper is forbidden (ADR-002).

relativePath.description: Path relative to the manifest's own folder. Absolute paths and '..' traversal are forbidden so the binding survives folder renames and category moves.

source_id.description: Stable random UUIDv4. Used as the only resource API key (never the path).

role.description: Explicit role. Guide vs full translation vs MinerU extraction must not collapse into one scalar field.

primary.description: At most one primary per role family. Default display prefers TRANSLATION_FULL > TRANSLATION_GUIDE > EXTRACTED_MARKDOWN > OTHER_MARKDOWN.

active.description: false marks a superseded binding without deleting it (zero-delete).
